payload.goal: Bokfør kvitteringen fra Elkjøp i avdeling Markedsføring med korrekt kostnadsføring og 25% mva-behandling.
success_checks: Leverandør/utsteder Elkjøp er registrert eller referert med org.nr 815851404
Avdeling Markedsføring er opprettet og knyttet til bilaget
Alle tre linjer fra kvitteringen er bokført: Tastatur, Kaffemøte, Overnatting
Mva-behandling er satt til 25% i tråd med kvitteringsteksten
risk_notes: Prompten sier 'riktig oppwandskonto', men eksakt kontonummer er ikke oppgitt; må velges fra kontoplan basert på regnskapspraksis.
Kvitteringen inneholder blandede kostnadstyper; én samlet mva-sats på 25% er oppgitt, men konto kan måtte splittes per linje.
Ingen informasjon om hvilken ansatt eller korttransaksjon som skal knyttes til kjøpet.
Ingen betalingskonto/kredittkortkonto er oppgitt; motkonto for bedriftskort må avklares.
Elkjøp som butikk og varelinjene Kaffemøte/Overnatting kan være uvanlig kombinasjon på samme kvittering; bør verifiseres.
ordered_steps: Check whether department 'Markedsføring' exists; if not, POST /department to create it.
Create supplier Elkjøp with org.nr 815851404 via POST /supplier if supplier master is required for voucher reference.
Upload attachment from files/kvittering_de_03.pdf and store attachment reference.

Resolve ledger accounts: keyboard to office/IT equipment expense, kaffemøte to representation/meeting expense, overnatting to travel/accommodation expense; use department Markedsføring on all relevant lines.
Create voucher dated 2026-03-30 via POST /voucher with three expense lines, 25% VAT handling, and balancing credit to company card/clearing account.
Attach uploaded receipt to the voucher.
Verify voucher totals equal 5770.00 and VAT amount aligns with receipt text.

planned_endpoints.summary: Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.
Create a new free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimension
Create a new value for one of the free (aka 'user defined') accounting dimensions
Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.

rules: Use ?number=XXXX to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
Do NOT use other query params — they are not supported.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
